description: This file defines the Cbor class within the cuttlefish::confui namespace, which is responsible for creating and managing CBOR-encoded messages, including handling UTF-8 validation and message size constraints. It includes methods for constructing CBOR maps with prompt text and extra data, checking the status of the message, and retrieving the encoded message.

classes.name: Cbor
classes.description: A class for creating and managing CBOR-encoded messages, including validation and size management.

methods.name: Cbor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Cbor object with prompt text and extra data, and sets up internal state.

methods.name: IsOk
methods.description: Checks if the current buffer status indicates success.

methods.name: GetErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the current error code of the buffer.

methods.name: IsMessageTooLong
methods.description: Checks if the message exceeds the maximum allowed size.

methods.name: IsMalformedUtf8
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has a UTF-8 malformed error.

methods.name: GetMessage
methods.description: Returns the encoded CBOR message as a vector of bytes, only if the state is OK.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the CBOR map and internal state.

methods.name: CheckUTF8Copy
methods.description: Validates that the provided string is valid UTF-8.
